parts.name: wolf
sources: Quaternius, Animal Pack Vol.2 (2017): Dog.fbx. https://opengameart.org/content/animated-animales-low-poly CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A gray wolf: about 80 cm at the shoulder, long legs, a deep and narrow chest, a long muzzle, ears up, a thick tail that hangs down.
A gray wolf (Canis lupus): 66 to 92 cm at the shoulder, 105 to 160 cm long without the tail, a tail of 35 to 50 cm. The numbers of the shape are a guess from these sizes and from photos.
